name: @mooter/council
description: Mooter Council (Wave Council) — confidence-axis routing. Convenes a heterogeneous local-first council (free Ollama quorum + cheap cloud) when a single answer is not trustworthy, deliberates adversarially with adaptive stopping, and returns a verdict that exposes dissent instead of hiding it. Additive package: reads classify.js output, reuses validation/adversarial (review/vote), router (decideAgent), and workflow (parallel/converge). Never modifies frozen engine packages.
